why_this_file_exists: The R71 director ruled on the three CROSS_ASSET families the R59 queue is blocked on, and the ruling was written only into research_director_decision.json. The governor reads the R59 ResearchMemory, so the ruling reached no reader and the runtime went on sleeping on three jobs whose recorded blocker said 'waiting for information' while the director had ruled that the only information that could reopen them is not owned. This file is the SAME ruling, in the shape the canonical write path (scripts/alpha_agents_v2.py record-ruling --agent quant-research-director) accepts.
nothing_here_is_a_new_verdict: Each rationale is the director's own wording. The only thing added is the canonical blocker code implied by the director's stated reopen condition, so the taxonomy can carry the verdict. No hypothesis is created, no burden is spent, no job is mutated and no experiment identity changes.

rulings.rationale: ACCEPTED as one cell (C4) and REFUSED. Relative value is a PRICE_STATE relabel. What would reopen it: NOTHING from futures prices. Only genuinely non-price terms-of-trade information (national export/import price indices with vintages), which is not owned. Do not re-propose.

detail.why_this_blocker_code: the director names an information family that is identified but NOT OWNED, and says nothing computable from owned futures prices can reopen it. That is precisely WAITING_FOR_EXTERNAL_ENTITLEMENT - 'the information is identified but the estate is not entitled to it; only the purchase gate can change this state' - and it clears TERMINAL, not on INFORMATION.
detail.recorded_queue_blocker_before_this_rulin: DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED (from the free text 'engine returned NO_MEMBERS'), which clears on INFORMATION
